source: GDD gdd/lanebound-champions-v4.0-notion.md (Lanebound v4.0, L7 kit); look from champions/portraits/painted/isra/isra-1024.png (CD-7)
note: Blue faces right and red faces left. Blit at (round(sx)-9, round(sy)-23). Team tint only on the strap clasp. Goggles are antique brass, dE > 40 from #F2C14E. Pure DPS: shells, blasts, smoke and recoil only; no plates, no CC language.

idle.note: breath; mortar on the right shoulder, fuse spark blinks

attack.note: long fuse shot (range 7): tube tilts, fuse sparks, shot leaves the muzzle on 3 with a recoil kick; lobbed shell with spark trail

cast.note: generic cast: goggles down, fuse lit

longsight.note: Passive Long Sight: goggles flip down over the eyes (1-2), lens glint (3-5); autos and skills on targets 5+ tiles away hit 8% harder

fuse.note: Q Fuse Shot: kneel and tilt (1), strike the fuse (2), burn (3), fire on 4 (0.30 s cast); shell lands 1.0 s after the cast, r 1.4, range 8.5, ground ring meanwhile

recoil.note: W Recoil Step: tube swung at the ground (1), spark (2), blast on 3 (0.15 s cast) throws him 2.5 tiles back (3-6, real move); no damage, no CC

starfall.note: R Starfall Mortar: plant the tube (1), load (2), light (3-4), volley on 5/6/7 (first at 0.50 s); bright ground ring r 3.4 up to 12 tiles; shells land 1.2 s after the cast; damage only

death.note: tube drops, kneel, fall; last frame holds
